error_string: back-off restarting failed container: Error (exit code 1)

content.text:
Error: Container keeps crashing and Kubernetes is waiting before restart attempts. The container exits with error code 1.

Solution: 1) Check logs: kubectl logs <pod-name> 2) Review container image & code 3) Verify resource limits 4) Check env variables 5) Fix app issues 6) Redeploy
